findings.r3_conclusion: Extraction is exact. The sealed result node routes every uncertain scheduling result straight to the silent end_call, so the generated uncertain_explanation node is reachable only by a model mis-route, never after a real uncertain result. findings.conclusion: Changed in a1. Every uncertain scheduling result still goes from the sealed result node to bg_quarantine with no write and no close, and bg_quarantine now speaks the fixed line "the result of this request could not be confirmed" (message_mode custom, a documented end_call mode). The policy sets uncertain_stop_explanation true instead of quoting the source words. Ruling 6109327617 accepts this for brief line 69. Residual: the same line is spoken on every quarantine path, including an input failure before any request, where line 21 asks only for an input-failure end with no bank request. The model node uncertain_booking is still reachable only by a mis-route, and the kernel decides any close after it.

findings.conclusion: The policy extracts HTTP200 as the success status, and the OpenAPI declares only 200 and 503 for schedule_callback. The sealed result check (builder/guards.py, generic) accepts any 2xx with a true flag, and the profile has no field to narrow it. An undeclared 201-299 reply with accepted "true" would be acknowledged and closed with R10 instead of stopping as uncertain. Documented paths are unaffected. This is the same class as F-04 (evidence the documented bank never sends), so it is classified the same way.
